title: Wholesome German Flatbread
description: A classic German flatbread recipe made with wholesome ingredients, perfect for serving with soups or stews.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and yeast. Whisk to combine.
2. Gradually add water to the bowl, mixing until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a warm place to rise for 1 hour.
6. Punch down the dough and divide into 4-6 equal pieces.
7. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
8. Brush with water and sprinkle with crushed bread.
9. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.
